{
  "test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection3",
  "test_code": "using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection3\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task GeneratedEnumUnionAndResolverCarryExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute()\n    {\n        string source = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace TestNamespace\n{\n    public enum MyEnum\n    {\n        First = 0,\n        Second = 1,\n    }\n\n    [Union(0, typeof(SubA))]\n    [Union(1, typeof(SubB))]\n    public interface IMyUnion\n    {\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class SubA : IMyUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class SubB : IMyUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class MyObject\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public MyEnum EnumProp { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(1)]\n        public IMyUnion UnionProp { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80Refs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        var references = net80Refs.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation output, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.Empty(runResult.Diagnostics);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(output.GetDiagnostics(), d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(typeof(ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute).FullName!);\n        Assert.NotNull(excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? myEnumSymbol = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TestNamespace.MyEnum\");\n        INamedTypeSymbol? myUnionSymbol = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TestNamespace.IMyUnion\");\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterInterface = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.Formatters.IMessagePackFormatter`1\");\n        INamedTypeSymbol? resolverInterface = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.IFormatterResolver\");\n\n        Assert.NotNull(myEnumSymbol);\n        Assert.NotNull(myUnionSymbol);\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterInterface);\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverInterface);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? enumFormatterType = null;\n        INamedTypeSymbol? unionFormatterType = null;\n        INamedTypeSymbol? resolverType = null;\n\n        foreach (GeneratedSourceResult generatedSource in runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources))\n        {\n            SemanticModel semanticModel = output.GetSemanticModel(generatedSource.SyntaxTree);\n            SyntaxNode root = await generatedSource.SyntaxTree.GetRootAsync();\n            foreach (ClassDeclarationSyntax classDecl in root.DescendantNodes().OfType<ClassDeclarationSyntax>())\n            {\n                INamedTypeSymbol? typeSymbol = semanticModel.GetDeclaredSymbol(classDecl);\n                if (typeSymbol is null)\n                {\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                if (typeSymbol.AllInterfaces.Any(i => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(i, resolverInterface)))\n                {\n                    resolverType = typeSymbol;\n                }\n\n                INamedTypeSymbol? formatterImpl = typeSymbol.AllInterfaces.FirstOrDefault(i =>\n                    SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(i.OriginalDefinition, formatterInterface));\n                if (formatterImpl is not null && formatterImpl.TypeArguments.Length == 1)\n                {\n                    ITypeSymbol targetType = formatterImpl.TypeArguments[0];\n                    if (SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(targetType, myEnumSymbol))\n                    {\n                        enumFormatterType = typeSymbol;\n                    }\n                    else if (SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(targetType, myUnionSymbol))\n                    {\n                        unionFormatterType = typeSymbol;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Assert.NotNull(enumFormatterType);\n        Assert.NotNull(unionFormatterType);\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverType);\n\n        Assert.True(\n            HasExcludeFromCodeCoverage(enumFormatterType!, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr!),\n            $\"Expected {enumFormatterType!.ToDisplayString()} to have [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage].\");\n        Assert.True(\n            HasExcludeFromCodeCoverage(unionFormatterType!, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr!),\n            $\"Expected {unionFormatterType!.ToDisplayString()} to have [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage].\");\n        Assert.True(\n            HasExcludeFromCodeCoverage(resolverType!, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr!),\n            $\"Expected {resolverType!.ToDisplayString()} to have [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage].\");\n    }\n\n    private static bool HasExcludeFromCodeCoverage(INamedTypeSymbol typeSymbol, INamedTypeSymbol excludeAttrSymbol)\n    {\n        return typeSymbol.GetAttributes().Any(a =>\n            SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(a.AttributeClass, excludeAttrSymbol));\n    }\n}\n"
}
